segs.t: I got a question from someone saying,
if you're making money with your e-commerce store,
why the fuck are you doing coaching?
Well, what is your opinion on that, you know?
Yeah, so I think there's a few factors to it.
Number one, I think coaching or consultancy
allow you to open up a massive network.
Imagine you want to go out and network
with like-minded people.
At the same time, you can actually learn from them
and understand what they're doing,
and you get that value and you get paid for it.
I think that is number one.
And number two, obviously, free coaching,
you've learned so much.
You've paid a lot of money to get the value,
to get the source.
You can actually package it up,
optimize it towards how you guys do things
and share it with the world.
And through sharing the world,
you can actually create success for obviously your students,
people that are learning to run E-com, right?
People that actually want to earn
and create a living for themselves.
In the world, it's all about balance.
You can't just expect to give out things for free, right?
There has to be some sort of balance,
and obviously you guys get paid for your experience,
your skill set, and your value,
which I think it's an equal trade.
